'''Koh-Lanta: La Revanche des Héros''' (in English ''The Revenge of the Heroes'') is the 3rd special season of the [[France|French]] version of ''[[Survivor (franchise)|Survivor]]'', ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. This season takes place in [[Cambodia]] on the island of [[Koh Rong]], and was broadcast on [[TF1]] in April 2012, every Friday at 8:45pm (7:45&nbsp;p.m. GMT).

This season includes contestants of old season of Koh-Lanta who had not won. This season survival conditions are harder: they begin the game without rice, they can't win the fire (they have to make it)<ref>{{in lang|fr}} [http://www.tf1.fr/koh-lanta/news/ni-feu-ni-riz-collier-d-immunite-et-vote-noir-7114876.html No fire, no rice] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120510040252/http://www.tf1.fr/koh-lanta/news/ni-feu-ni-riz-collier-d-immunite-et-vote-noir-7114876.html |date=2012-05-10 }} on ''Koh-Lanta official website'', the April 5, 2012</ref> and one of the immunity challenges is a playoff.<ref>{{in lang|fr}} [http://tvmag.lefigaro.fr/programme-tv/article/divertissement/67199/koh-lanta-les-secrets-de-la-revanche-des-heros_.html#sondage Secrets of the Revenge of the heroes] on ''TVMagazine/LeFigaro.fr'', the March 16, 2012</ref>

==Future appearances==
Isabelle Da Silva, Freddy Boucher and Teheiura Teahui returned for ''[[:fr:Koh-Lanta : La Nouvelle Édition|Koh-Lanta: La Nouvelle Édition]]''. Teahui returned once again alongside Claude Dartois and Moussa Niangane for ''[[Koh-Lanta: L'Île des héros]]''. Boucher returned alongside Teahui, Patrick Merle, Coumba Baradji, and Dartois to compete in ''[[Koh-Lanta: La Légende]]''.
